Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A short jobs-report update says unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant describes itself as a cozy, alpine-inspired restaurant serving traditional Swiss dishes, including cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. It highlights rustic wooden interiors, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The content is straightforward and makes your contact email easy to find, which is helpful. I think adding a short introduction about yourself and what visitors can expect from the site would make it more engaging and informative.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning your love of hiking gives the blog a personal touch and a clear starting point. Based on the content available, I'd love to see more detail—such as posts about favorite trails, trip stories, or hiking tips—to give readers more to explore.
